entities.name: Ibn al-Qaisarani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu al-Fadl Muhammad ibn Tahir ibn Ali al-Qaysarani, known simply as Ibn Tahir, was an Islamic scholar, historian and traditionist. He is largely credited with being the first to delineate and define the Six Books of Sunni Islam after the Qur'an, and the first person to include Sunan Ibn Maja as a canonical work.
